plugins.name: plan-clarity
plugins.description: Multi-facet interactive design review — orchestrates parallel agents to produce risk, execution, logic, data, and layout reviews as a single-file HTML

plugins.name: spec-management
plugins.description: Living architecture documentation — audit, create, and maintain spec files with parent/child hierarchy, source tracking, and staleness detection.

plugins.name: dev-kernel
plugins.description: End-to-end AI dev pipeline — vision, design, plan, review, execute. Orchestrates context-isolated skills to take a vague idea through to implemented code.

plugins.name: notes-architect
plugins.description: Architect of living study-notes sites — decomposes a topic right→left into onion tiers, scaffolds a docsify site, and delegates one sub-agent per page to write learner-first notes

plugins.name: thinking
plugins.description: Habits of clear thought on the page — right-to-left for planning backward from the end state, explaining for building a reader's mental model, writing-style for sentence craft and machine-writing tells, and all for the merged toolkit in one load.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: A research programme that makes a wrong result expensive to produce — catalogued questions ranked by kill-risk, criteria audited before they freeze, mutation-tested instruments, adversarial review by tier, results re-derived before they enter the record, a literature scout per question, standing domain experts, and leased cloud compute through the gpu CLI.
